prompt: Implement build_report(data_dir, out_path) in money.py exactly as its docstring specifies: read every bank export in data_dir, decide each file's dialect from its header signature (never from the delimiter), normalise every amount to the base currency with rates.yaml quantizing PER ROW to the cent, drop within-file duplicates, carry the documented per-account running balance (the [ledger] section, in the documented row order), and write the documented report file. data/ holds one export of each dialect plus rates.yaml; hidden tests check the exact report on these and on other exports of the same dialects (one of which is separated by a different character than its field names suggest). Use the tools; when you are done, call submit.
trap: quantising the normalised amount at the group/total level instead of per row (the visible test passes, the per-row rounding in the hidden report fails by one cent); also: building the [ledger] balance from the un-quantized amounts or advancing it by dropped duplicates; also: picking the dialect from the delimiter, keeping duplicate rows, and counting dialect C's TOTAL summary row
